description: Shapes websites and landing pages around ethical persuasion and commercial action by clarifying the offer, audience, decision stage, value hierarchy, objections, proof, trust signals, calls to action, page sequence, forms, and conversion friction. Use when the user asks to improve leads, bookings, purchases, sign-ups, inquiries, demo requests, phone calls, applications, or another measurable action without sacrificing brand quality, accessibility, or user trust.
